data.title: board --json returns the summary shape by default; the full history moves behind --history
data.why: G5 asks that board --json stop growing with history. Measured 2026-10-12: 17 KB at 30 events, 82 KB at 300, about 240 B per event, while --summary stays at 7.5 KB. An agent that does not know the flag pays for the whole history on every call, and agents are who calls board --json. A 0.x release may change the contract with a ⚠️ section (DOC-65).
data.rejected: Keep the full shape as the default and call --summary the fix: the gate is about what an agent gets without knowing a flag; Trim history to the last N events per task: a third shape to explain, and N is arbitrary
